# Fusion360 MCP Server

> MCP server that lets AI coding agents drive Autodesk Fusion 360: primitives,
> sketching, features, assemblies, sheet metal, CAM, measurement and export — 96
> tools over the Model Context Protocol, with errors returned as structured data.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/README.md):
  install from a tag, behaviour worth knowing (centimetres, 30 s bridge timeout, undo
  semantics), and troubleshooting.
- [docs/TOOLS.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md):
  all 96 tools with descriptions, grouped by category.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  instructions for AI coding agents — commands, architecture, conventions, and the
  boundaries that matter.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  dev setup, the PR rules (`main` needs a reviewed PR), and the release process.

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  the main-thread bridge, the error envelope, and the sketch/undo semantics that
  surprise people.
- [examples/model-a-bracket.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/examples/model-a-bracket.md):
  a worked session with the envelopes to expect.
- [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/SUPPORT.md):
  where to ask what.

## Reference

- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/SECURITY.md):
  private reporting, supported versions, and the deliberate local-trust model of the
  add-in socket.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  what changed in each tagged release.
- [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](https://github.com/shinobi81/fusion360-mcp-server/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md):
  upstream MIT attribution. The project itself is AGPL-3.0-or-later.

## Optional

- [Upstream project](https://github.com/faust-machines/fusion360-mcp-server): this
  repository is a maintained continuation; upstream has had no merges since
  2026-10-06.
